gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.5: Mr. Krabguh wants jelly jam on the Nibble Patties, and Patguh knows everything about jellies. Walk south from The Krusty Nibble to Conch Street: Patguh is asleep in front of his big brown crumb rock (column of light).
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.5: Patguh's crumb rock on Conch Street, in the south of town
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.5_b: Catch eight crumb jellies with Patguh's net: tap a jelly (left or right click). The Jelly Field is at the west end of Conch Street; Patguh waits at its edge.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.5: The Jelly Field at the west end of Conch Street
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.kort.5: Catch 8 crumb jellies (west end of Conch Street)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.6: Spongeguh is taking his boating exam, and you are his driving buddy. Walk to Mrs. Puffguh at the start line of the Boating School, on the west side of town next to the pylon course (column of light).
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.6: Mrs. Puffguh at the Boating School, in the west of town
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.6_b: Click the practice boat at the start line and sail one lap: follow the lights, over the little bridge and back to the finish. Bump into things eight times at most. Spongeguh screams enough for two.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.6: The start line of the pylon course, in the west of town
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.intr: Ah, Patguh Star. He likes to sleep. And when he is done sleeping... he sleeps one more time. Magnifique.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.snur: Zzzz... five more minutes... zzzz... five more jellies...
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.wakk: Huh?! Is it tomorrow already? Oh no, it's still today. Phew, I was just getting used to it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.jam: Hey, you're the new one at The Krusty Nibble! Mr. Krabguh wants jelly jam on the Nibble Patties. And I know everything about jellies. Almost everything. I know they're called jellies.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.net: Here, a net for you! Just tap them gently, then floop, it's in the jar. Eight jellies and the jar is full.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_patguh.veld: The Jelly Fields are at the end of the street, to the west. Last one there is a rotten jelly! Nyeg!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_knipoog_roo: Bloop. Bloop. I am a jelly. Bloop.
GOTCHA! Look! This is the biggest jelly I have ever caught!
Hey! He's taking my net! ...Oh well. He needs it more.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kwallen_kla: And so, with eight jellies in a jar, a hero was born. A sticky hero, nyeg.
EIGHT! The jar is full! Mr. Krabguh is going to dance with joy. Or count money. Usually count money.
Here, three jars of jam for you. And my spare trunks with little flowers! They'll look lovely on you. On me too, by the way.
Oh right! Spongeguh is taking his boating exam today. Again. He's already shaking at the Boating School in the west. Will you go and help him? I'd go myself, but I still have to rest from resting.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.onde: Meanwhile, at the Boating School... Mrs. Puffguh has seen a great many exams. Too many, say her nerves.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.numm: Spongeguh Cheesepants. Exam number... thirty-eight. I wrote a little song about it. It is very short and it ends with screaming.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.klaa: This time it's going to work, miss! I've practised! In my head! And look: I brought a driving buddy!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.maat: A driving buddy? ...Fine. You steer, Spongeguh sits beside you. Then his hands are free for screaming.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.rege: One lap of the course: follow the lights, over the little bridge and back to the finish. You may bump into things eight times at most. Easy does it, nyeg?
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.pani: I'm ready! ...Am I ready? I'm... a teeny bit ready. My little ears are trembling.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_pufguh.boot: The practice boat is at the start line, a little way to the north. Get in, and above all: breathe.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_knipoog_guh: You shall not... pass... without a licence!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_examen_klaa: A pass? A PASS! Miss, I've got my licence! I'm going to frame it! And then frame the frame!
For now, Spongeguh. For. Now. You may only sail with your driving buddy beside you. It says so on it, in very big letters.
Did you hear that? We're a team! The best boat team in all of Bikini Bottom!
But far away, at The Krusty Nibble, a bell rang. Not just any bell. The bell that must never ring...
Mr. Krabguh's alarm bell! That means something bad. Or something very bad! Quick, back to The Krusty Nibble!
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_patguh: Patguh lives under the big crumb rock on Conch Street. He is asleep in front of it.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_kwalle: At the west end of Conch Street the crumb jellies float. Patguh waits at the edge.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_pufguh: Mrs. Puffguh waits at the start line of her pylon course, on the west side of town.
scene.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kijk_boot.t: The practice boat is ready at the start line. Click it to get in; Spongeguh hops in too.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.patguh: Walk to Patguh: he is asleep in front of his big crumb rock on Conch Street, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.kwallen: To the Jelly Fields at the west end of Conch Street, %s. Tap eight crumb jellies with your net!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.pufguh: Walk to Mrs. Puffguh at the start line of the Boating School, on the west side of town, %s.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.hint.boot: Click the practice boat at the start line, %s, and sail the course.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.regel: Tap a jelly with your net (left or right click). Catch %s!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.pauze: Your jar is at %s/%s. Come back to the Jelly Field to catch more.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.niet_: Patguh only catches jellies in the Jelly Field next to him, nyeg.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.al: That one was in your jar already and slipped out again. Try another one!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.kwallen.belon: You get three jars of jelly jam and Patguh's Flower Trunks (for your guh)!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.regel: Follow the lights. Bump %s times at most!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.instap: Click the practice boat to get in (again).
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.start_: Seatbelts on! Oh wait, there are no seatbelts. Hold hands then!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.2: My little ears! My little ears saw my life flash by!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.3: That was a pylon! Or a post! Or my whole future!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.4: Everything's fine! Everything's fine! EVERYTHING'S FINE!
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.gil.5: I can see my nibble-fruit house already! Is that heaven?
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.opnieu: No worries: the boat is back at the start.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.examen.zucht: Pffff... One more time then. I'll puff myself up a little in advance.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.patguh_v: Tap them with your net! %s more and the jar is full. I'm counting along. On my fingers. I don't have that many.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.sponsguh: Jellyfishing with Patguh? That's the most fun thing there is! After baking Nibble Patties. And after blowing bubbles.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.pufguh_b: The practice boat is at the start line. Follow the lights, and when Spongeguh screams: just keep sailing.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.sponsguh: I'm ready! Get in, driving buddy!
My exam! Mrs. Puffguh is waiting at the Boating School. I'm coming. My knees aren't yet, but the rest of me is.
gui.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad.klik.patguh_e: Spongeguh is taking his exam again. I'd go and watch, but then I'd have to get up.
item.guhs.einde2_sp_d1_stad_kwallennet.l: A gift from Patguh. Tap gently, then floop!
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d1_stad_r5: Patguh knows everything about jellies. Almost everything. Help him catch eight &dcrumb jellies&r for the jelly jam of The Krusty Nibble.
ftb.guhs_guheinde.q.einde2_sp_d1_stad_r6: Spongeguh is taking his boating exam. For the thirty-eighth time. You are his &ddriving buddy&r: steer Mrs. Puffguh's practice boat around the pylon course.
